verdict.rationale: React is a UI component library for rendering web and native interfaces. Setting up user-configured automations that run autonomously in the background is a feature of agent or automation platforms, not a fair axis for a UI rendering library. Nothing in the evidence shows React ships any automation, scheduling, or background-agent capability that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
